''' Related Zones: ''' | [[Temple of Veeshan]] |- ! ''' Related NPCs: ''' | Dragons (West Wing) |} Ally faction with [[Kromzek]] is required for all Kael armor quests. [[King Tormax (Faction)]] is also quite helpful, as [[Kragek Thunderforge]] is located behind Tormax's throne room, which is populated by his (very nasty) guards. Below are the stat totals for a full set of armor with 1 bracer.
== Reward == {{Gear Set |Golden Star Headband |Golden Star Chest Wraps |Golden Star Arm Wraps |Golden Star Wrist Wraps |Fist of the Golden Star |Golden Star Pants |Golden Star Slippers }} == Checklist == Turn-ins to [[Dagron Stonecutter]] in [[Kael Drakkal]].{{CheckboxList}} *[[Golden Star Headband]] :*[[Ancient Leather Cap]] :*3x [[Crushed Coral]] *[[Golden Star Chest Wraps]] :*[[Ancient Leather Tunic]] :*3x [[Flawless Diamond]] *[[Golden Star Arm Wraps]] :*[[Ancient Leather Sleeves]] :*3x [[Flawed Emerald]] *[[Golden Star Wrist Wraps]] :*[[Ancient Leather Bracelet]] :*3x [[Crushed Flame Emerald]] *[[Fist of the Golden Star]] :*[[Ancient Leather Gloves]] :*3x [[Crushed Topaz]] *[[Golden Star Pants]] :*[[Ancient Leather Leggings]] :*3x [[Flawed Sea Sapphire]] *[[Golden Star Slippers]] :*[[Ancient Leather Boots]] :*3x [[Crushed Black Marble]] {{End}} == Walkthrough == ''You say, 'Hail, Dagron Stonecutter' Dagron Stonecutter says, 'Greetings to you. I seek one who has chosen the path of monkhood. What do you call yourself?''' You say, 'I am a monk' Dagron Stonecutter says, 'Good. I had hoped you were one. As seeker of the way you are in constant training to push yourself to your physical and mental limits. It is an admirable quality and I wish to aid you. I will provide you with a cap, a tunic, sleeves, bracers, gloves, leggings and boots. After handing in your items: Dagron Stonecutter smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well, _____.'
* Your faction standing with [[Kromzek]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Kromrif]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[King Tormax (Faction)|King Tormax]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Claws of Veeshan]] got worse.
== Helm == ''You say, 'what cap' Dagron Stonecutter says, 'I shall weave one of exceptional quality for you but you must gather the items first. I require an ancient leather cap and a set of three pieces of crushed coral.'' Dagron promises to make you a cap if you bring him an [[Ancient Leather Cap]] and three [[Crushed Coral]] pieces. == Tunic == ''You say, 'what tunic' Dagron Stonecutter says, 'You shall be an imposing force with this tunic. Solid as the unmoving mountains, it shall protect you. Once I have gained an ancient leather tunic and three flawless diamonds, the item is yours.'' Dagron promises to make you a tunic if you bring him an [[Ancient Leather Tunic]] and three [[Flawless Diamond]]s. == Sleeves == ''You say, 'what sleeves' Dagron Stonecutter says, 'As the mighty stone that parts the flow of water, so shall these sleeves divert harm against you. Bring me three flawed emeralds and a pair of ancient leather sleeves.'' Dagron promises to make you some sleeves if you bring him a pair of an [[Ancient Leather Sleeves]] and three [[Flawed Emerald]]s. == Bracer == ''You say, 'what bracers' Dagron Stonecutter says, 'For a bracer I shall require an ancient leather bracelet and a set of three crushed flame emeralds. Do this and the reward shall be yours to keep'' Dagron promises to make you a bracer if you bring him an [[Ancient Leather Bracelet]], and three [[Crushed Flame Emerald]]s. == Gauntlets == ''You say, 'what gloves' Dagron Stonecutter says, 'Your hands are like the wind, everflowing and moving. Subtle one moment, then a howling wind raining blow upon blow to your foes. These gloves shall aid you. In order to complete them I require a pair of ancient leather gloves and three crushed topaz.'' Dagron promises to make you some gloves if you bring him a pair of an [[Ancient Leather Gloves]] and three [[Crushed Topaz]]. == Leggings == ''You say, 'what leggings' Dagron Stonecutter says, 'The leggings shall protect you, as the valley shelters the still pool within its center from the howling winds. Furnish a pair of ancient leather leggings and a set of three flawed sea sapphires for me and they are yours.'' Dagron promises to make you some leggings if you bring him a pair of an [[Ancient Leather Leggings]] as well as three [[Flawed Sea Sapphire]]s. == Boots == ''You say, 'what boots' Dagron Stonecutter says, 'Your feet are hard as any stone and as swift as a coiled serpent but even the swiftest feet require protection so I shall provide you with these. They should help. Acquire a pair of ancient tarnished boots and three crushed pieces of black marble.'' Dagron promises to make you some boots if you bring him a pair of [[Ancient Leather Boots]] and three [[Crushed Black Marble]] pieces.
